hypothesis: On a separately frozen admitted finite-graph heavy-tailed unnormalized real-feature denoising pack,the deterministic expected-median3 resolvent smoother will reduce mean pi-weighted l1 clean-signal error by at least10% against the strongest qualified old baseline per case on at least two thirds of core cases,with no case suffering more than5% relative risk loss,while an independent finite judge certifies source energy<=3024 times Cesaro cost and declared full time/memory budgets. Freeze fixtures,seeds,input scales,t,tuning,baseline qualification,zero-risk handling and independent judge before any numerical output;the source theorem alone does not imply this denoising prediction.

input.exposure: F332 source and three historical scopes read WP084;one-hot7/9 source-interface example known symbolically beforehand,not blind discovery or benchmark outcome. No benchmark fixture noise,algorithm risk or timing output computed before this spec.
input.scope: Finite small reversible stationary chains and unnormalized R^2/R^4 features;not telemetry deployment,global state-of-the-art comparison,theorem proof or incremental l1 theorem validation by scalar controls alone.
input.chain: W symmetric listed positive edges,zero loops;Dmax=max row sum;A=I-(diag(deg)-W)/(2Dmax);pi_i=1/n. All exact rational,lazy,connected. Graph and kernel full costs included.
input.noise: For each coordinate independently draw K as number of consecutive one bits from Random.getrandbits(1) before first zero;draw next bit sign (1->+1,0->-1);eta=scale*sign*2^K. Ideal K law P(K=k)=2^-(k+1) yields discrete power-law amplitude tail;finite observed synthetic sample,not claim representing every real heavy-tailed process. K>64 invalidates pack (no clipping or reselection).
input.seed_derivation: Random(int.from_bytes(sha256(f"{root_seed}|{graph_id}|{profile_id}|{scale}".encode()).digest(),"big"));coordinates drawn node-major then coordinate-major;scale string preserved exactly.
input.core: Cartesian3graphs x3profiles x2noise_scales;8heldout draws each. Training4independent draws for each case;no core deletion or seed tuning.
input.scalar_controls: path5 atscale1/4,constant1=(1) andramp1=(i/(n-1));train seeds same4,test first2. Old exact scalar quadratic source-objective minimizer checked;not counted among18corecases or risk wins.
input.selection: For each case and method family choose parameter with smallest mean training pi-weighted l1 clean risk;ties use listed parameter order. Hold fixed across all8test seeds. Identity has no parameter. No test-based tuning. Report best heldout-risk family among qualified old methods as conservative ORACLE diagnostic comparator per case;this is not a deployable selector. Also report all family risks and training choices.

methods.candidate: G=(I+t(I-A))^-1;deterministic expected median of3independent row-G endpoint indices. Sorted coordinate threshold gaps times3h^2-2h^3. All exact rational.
methods.weighted_median: Per output node/coordinate choose lowest observed value whose cumulative row-G weight>=1/2;minimizes row-weighted absolute deviation. Same qualified G family,own training-selected t;not reproduction of Ge etal temporal recursive graph filter.
methods.quadratic: Unique minimizer sum_i pi_i||y_i-x_i||2^2+alpha sum_ij pi_i aij||y_i-y_j||2^2,solution (I+2alpha(I-A))^-1x for reversible chain. Standard graph Tikhonov reference,own train-selected alpha. This is Euclidean/separable convex reference,not full multidimensional squared-l1 source-objective optimum or TV solver.

judges.kernel: Exact stochastic/nonnegative rows and full matrix residual G*(I+t(I-A))=I. Strictly diagonally-dominant matrix nonsingular;residual certifies exact solution without another inverse routine.
judges.constructor: Independent grouped enumeration of unordered triples j<=k<=l with multiplicities1/3/6 and product row probabilities;coordinate median=a+b+c-min-max. No CDF or cubic formula in reference.
judges.weighted_median: For each output coordinate evaluate weighted absolute objective at every distinct observed candidate value and certify minimality of selected median.
judges.quadratic: Exact first-order residual;strict convex fidelity certifies unique optimum of declared quadratic objective. Scalar controls also compare source energy against all other produced outputs,not multidimensional optimum.
judges.energy: Whole squared l1 distances,not sum coordinate squared distances. Direct row loops for fidelity+t one-step energy and Cesaro powers1..t;check exact <=3024*cost for every fast candidate output on train and test. No tolerance.
judges.risk: Exact mean pi-weighted l1 distance to frozen clean features across heldout seeds;independent absolute-coordinate arithmetic;store every input and output.
judges.zero_risk: Old mean risk0/new0 ->tie,no10%win,noharm. Old0/new>0 ->harm. Otherwise win when10*new<=9*old;harm when20*new>21*old. No division-based tolerance.

resources: Standard library only,no downloads/optimizer/Lean/ML install. Full wall cap includes generation,all training choices,all selected testing algorithms,independent judges;per-method preprocessing/evaluation timing and cache-use reported. Full graph inputs/kernels cost retained;no speed gain predicted.
stop: Run frozen pack once;retain all outcomes and failures;no noise/t/threshold grid expansion or changed10%prediction to find support. If resource envelope fails or pack incomplete,it cannot count as completed application initial check.
outputs: Use shared experiment runner;raw and summary plus all spec/code/config snapshots gzip-archived with exact SHA roundtrips. Store timing separately from deterministic scientific replay comparison.
